protocol.eval: online greedy (deterministic=True),10 evaluator workers,per-task1000-completed-episode moving window; model publications can occur inside an episode
protocol.rollout: stochastic real environment collection; separate1000-completed-episode moving window
protocol.success: environment info.is_success; LiberoEnvWrapper uses environment done as success and independent horizon220 truncation
protocol.initial_states: same benchmark task0 initial_states asset as training; eval workers each cycle sequentially from index0 modulo pool size50; real collection globally shuffles the same50 states without replacement per cycle
protocol.seed_limit: Eval passes a distinct seed to wrapper.reset, but wrapper invokes underlying env.reset() without passing that seed. No exact per-episode underlying RNG-state audit was performed.
protocol.not_yet_tested: A fixed final checkpoint on a balanced paired initial-state plan or unseen tasks/states; current .95 is not such an estimate.

learning_recipe.bootstrap_refreshed: current critic values and GAE, original behavior policy logits retained

causality_limits: Four FRESH changes were enabled together; no per-feature causal attribution is available.
The historical seven-day baseline differs in World/Reward architecture and pretrained assets, training placement and warmup; wall-clock ratio is an observed run comparison.
Fewer policy updates do not imply fewer true environment samples; compare completed real action counters separately.
Continuous evaluation consumes compute but its frames do not enter Policy Replay in EvaluationWorkerActor.run.
Task0 repeated-state success is not all-task LIBERO performance or held-out-state generalization.
